name: The Brood of Onyxia
summary: Draz'Zilb fears Onyxia's brood has come for more than a siege against a few ogres.

sections.title: A Troubling Presence
sections.body: Draz'Zilb reports that Onyxia's brood has invaded Stonemaul Village. Onyxia is Deathwing's daughter, and her arrival troubles him. He is certain the brood seeks more than a siege against a few ogres. So you carry word to Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village, where he can take action.

sections.title: Word at Brackenwall
sections.body: Overlord Mok'Morokk does not welcome news of the brood at Stonemaul Village. He dislikes dragons, so he prefers Brackenwall Village and insists there are no dragons here.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk?
aliases: who starts the brood of onyxia
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb sends you to Overlord Mok'Morokk after Onyxia's brood invades Stonemaul Village.

faq.q: Where can Overlord Mok'Morokk be found?
faq.answer: Overlord Mok'Morokk can be found in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Why is Draz'Zilb concerned about Onyxia's brood?
aliases: why does draz'zilb care about dragons
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb wonders why Deathwing's daughter came to these lands. He is certain she came for more than a siege against a small band of ogres.
